questions.question: Who has been appointed as the next Vice Chief of the Army Staff (VCOAS) of the Indian Army, effective from April 1, 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lt Gen Dhiraj Seth.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Lt Gen Dhiraj Seth, currently the Southern Army Commander, has been appointed as the next Vice Chief of the Army Staff (VCOAS) effective April 1, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Current Role:** He is presently the General Officer Commanding-in-Chief (GOC-in-C) of the **Southern Command** based in Pune.
 
• **Succession:** He will succeed **Lt Gen P.P. Singh**, who is moving to head the **Western Command**.
 
• **Experience:** An Armoured Corps officer, he has previously commanded the XXI Strike Corps and the South Western Command.
 
• **Responsibilities:** As VCOAS, he will be the second-highest ranking officer in the Army, overseeing operational preparedness and modernization at Army HQ, New Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Indian Army Command Structure__

 __
 
• The Indian Army is divided into seven commands (6 operational and 1 training). The Southern Command is the largest in terms of geographical area.
 
 
 
• VCOAS (Vice Chief of the Army Staff)__
 
 
• A three-star rank officer (Lieutenant General) who assists the Chief of the Army Staff (COAS) in strategic and administrative functions.

questions.question: Who was confirmed as Mongolia's new prime minister by the parliament on March 31, 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Uchral Nyam-Osor​.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Mongolia's parliament confirmed Uchral Nyam-Osor as the nation's new prime minister with a vote of 88 out of 107 lawmakers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **During a parliamentary session, 88 out of the total 107 lawmakers voted to appoint Uchral Nyam-Osor to the country's top leadership post.**
 
• The newly appointed 39-year-old prime minister vowed to trim the bureaucracy and stabilize import prices in the coal-rich nation.
 
• He became the third prime minister in nine months, succeeding Zandanshatar Gombojav who resigned amid a legislative stalemate.
 
• The resignation and new appointment were part of a compromise to resolve a boycott by the opposition Democratic Party and factions within the ruling party.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• 107 lawmakers__

 __
 
• This represents the total number of lawmakers present in the Mongolian parliament for the session.
 
• Out of these 107, a majority of 88 voted in favor of Uchral Nyam-Osor.
 
 
 
• 39 years__
 __
 
• This number represents the age of the newly appointed prime minister, Uchral Nyam-Osor, rather than a vote count.
 
 
 
• Zandanshatar Gombojav__
 __
 
• The outgoing prime minister who resigned to resolve a two-week parliamentary boycott.
 
• He had assumed the post in June 2025 before stepping down.
 
 
 
• Luvsannamsrai Oyun-Erdene__
 
 
• A former prime minister of Mongolia who held the office prior to Zandanshatar Gombojav.
 
• He was ousted from his position following corruption allegations that erupted into street protests.

questions.question: Who is the Governor of Reserve Bank of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Sanjay Malhotra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sanjay Malhotra** is the current **Governor of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**.
 
• He assumed office as the RBI Governor in **December 2024**.
 
• The **Reserve Bank of India** is the **central bank of India** and regulates the country’s banking and monetary system.
 
• The RBI Governor is appointed by the **Government of India** for a fixed tenure.
 
• The Governor heads the **Monetary Policy Committee (MPC)**, which decides key policy rates such as the **Repo Rate**.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is Sanjay Malhotra.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** was established on **1 April 1935** under the **RBI Act, 1934**.
 
• The headquarters of RBI is located in **Mumbai, Maharashtra**.
 
• **Main Functions of RBI:**
 
 
• Issue of currency notes
 
• Control of monetary policy
 
• Regulation of banks
 
• Management of foreign exchange reserves
 
 
 
• **First RBI Governor:** **Sir Osborne Smith**.
 
• **First Indian RBI Governor:** **C. D. Deshmukh**.

questions.question: The new Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA) of India, appointed in November 2025, was _______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Vishvajit Sahay**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Vishvajit Sahay was appointed as the **Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA)** of India in November 2025.
 
• The CGDA is the principal advisor to the Ministry of Defence (MoD) on financial matters and is responsible for overseeing the defence accounts of the country.
 
• The CGDA is tasked with managing the accounts of defence services, including the Army, Navy, Air Force, and other organizations under the Ministry of Defence.
 
• Vishvajit Sahay has had a distinguished career in public administration, holding key positions in the Indian Government.
 
• The appointment of the CGDA is crucial for ensuring the financial integrity and accountability of defence-related expenditures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajesh Bansal**

 
 
• Rajesh Bansal is a financial expert and known for his contributions to the development of digital payment systems in India.
 
• He played a significant role in designing and implementing the Aadhaar-enabled payment system (AEPS).
 
• He is currently the CEO of the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub, focusing on fintech and digital financial inclusion.
 
 
 
• **Suresh Nanda**
 
 
• Suresh Nanda is a prominent businessman and former naval officer, not associated with any government financial or defence accounting roles.
 
• He is known for his business ventures in the hospitality and defence sectors.
 
 
 
• **Amit Singhal**
 
 
• Amit Singhal is a computer scientist and was a key figure at Google, where he led the development of Google Search for over a decade.
 
• He has no known association with the Indian defence or financial sectors.
 
 
 
• **Controller General of Defence Accounts (CGDA)**
 
 
• The CGDA is the head of the Indian Defence Accounts Department (DAD), which is responsible for the financial management of the Indian Armed Forces.
 
• The DAD manages payments, pensions, and internal audits for the defence sector.
 
• The CGDA also plays a key role in budgetary control and financial advice for the Ministry of Defence.

questions.question: Who became the youngest Prime Minister of the Netherlands in February 2026?
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is __Rob Jetten.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Rob Jetten took oath as the prime minister of the Netherlands in February 2026, becoming the youngest head of government in the country’s history.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Rob Jetten became prime minister on 23 February 2026.**
 
• **He assumed office at the age of 38, making him the youngest prime minister in Dutch history.**
 
• **He is also the country’s first openly gay prime minister.**
 
• **Jetten leads a minority coalition government comprising D66, Christian Democrats, and VVD.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Prime Minister:** The head of government responsible for running the executive branch in a parliamentary system.
 
• **Minority Coalition:** A government formed by multiple parties that collectively do not hold a majority of seats in the legislature.
 
• **D66 Party:** Democrats 66, a centrist and pro-European political party in the Netherlands.
 
• **Openly Gay Leader:** A significant milestone for LGBTQ+ representation in high political office.

questions.question: Who has been named by the Assembly of Experts as the new Supreme Leader of Iran?

questions.question: Yemen’s Presidential Leadership Council chief appointed Foreign Minister Shaya Mohsin Zindani as Prime Minister in January 2026. Whom did he replace from this position?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Salem bin Buriek.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Shaya Mohsin Zindani was appointed as the new Prime Minister of Yemen in January 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Outgoing Prime Minister:** Salem bin Buriek resigned from the post of Prime Minister.
 
• **New Appointment:** Shaya Mohsin Zindani, previously Yemen’s Foreign Minister, was appointed as Prime Minister.
 
• **Presidential Decree:** The appointment was made by the chief of Yemen’s Presidential Leadership Council.
 
• **Caretaker Government:** The outgoing government will continue in caretaker mode until a new Cabinet is formed.
 
• **New Role:** Salem bin Buriek was appointed as Advisor on financial and economic affairs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Presidential Leadership Council:** The executive governing body of Yemen formed to guide the country during its political transition.
 
• **Prime Minister of Yemen:** Heads the government and is responsible for forming the Cabinet and implementing state policies.
 
• **Caretaker Government:** A temporary government that continues routine administration until a new Cabinet is sworn in.
